description: Create a customer-typable promotion code (e.g. SUMMER20) for an existing Stripe coupon — the thing a "use code X" ad needs, since a coupon alone has no code. couponId (from list_stripe_coupons); optional code (letters, digits and dashes; Stripe generates one if omitted — a code with spaces or symbols is refused, never altered), maxRedemptions, expiresAt (YYYY-MM-DD), firstTimeOnly, minimumAmount + minimumAmountCurrency (major units), customerId. Read back. LIVE key: confirm:true after showing the preview. Use it on a payment link with allowPromotionCodes. Needs Stripe connected (Settings > Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

code.description: customer-typable code, letters, digits and dashes; Stripe generates one if omitted

confirm.description: true on a live key, after the user approves the preview

couponId.description: coupon id to apply, from list_stripe_coupons

customerId.description: restrict the code to one customer (cus_…)

expiresAt.description: last day the code works, YYYY-MM-DD

firstTimeOnly.description: true = valid only on a customer's first purchase

metadata.description: key/value metadata stored on the code

name: create_stripe_promotion_code
title: create stripe promotion code
